signature_type.name: arweave
signature_type.salt_length_rule: RSA_PSS_SALTLEN_MAX_SIGN = emLen - hLen - 2 = 512 - 32 - 2. NOT the digest length.
signature_type.public_exponent: 65537 (0x10001). Not carried on the wire; every implementation hardcodes it.

deep_hash.list_rule: acc = H('list' || decimal_ascii(count)); for each child: acc = H(acc || deepHash(child))

key.warning: THROWAWAY KEY. Generated for this corpus, published in the clear, never used for anything real.

notes: Signature bytes and data-item ids are NOT pinned as expectations: RSA-PSS is randomised, so signing identical input twice yields different bytes.
Everything under `expected` is deterministic and must match byte for byte.
`sample_signature` is a one-off fixture for testing a verifier, never an equality target.

vectors.name: empty-data-empty-tags
vectors.description: The degenerate item: no data, no tags, no target, no anchor. Pins the 1044-byte floor of the format and proves absent optional fields still contribute a zero-length blob to the deep hash.

vectors.description: The same content plus one byte, which crosses arbundles' internal 64-byte threshold and switches it to Buffer.write. Both paths must agree for well-formed input; this vector is the guard on that.

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-tag-short
vectors.description: KNOWN DIVERGENCE. An unpaired UTF-16 high surrogate (U+D800) in a tag value under 64 bytes. arbundles' hand-rolled encoder emits the raw code point as WTF-8 (ED A0 80) while declaring Buffer.byteLength (3), which is the length of the standard-UTF-8 replacement character. Standard UTF-8 would emit EF BF BD. Same width, different bytes, so nothing desyncs and nothing errors, a reimplementation just silently produces a different id.

encoding.note: DIVERGENCE: arbundles' tag bytes are NOT standard UTF-8 for this input. Its hand-rolled encoder (taken when the string's byte length is <= 64) writes unpaired UTF-16 surrogates as raw WTF-8 code points instead of substituting U+FFFD, while still declaring the standard-UTF-8 byte length. To reproduce arbundles byte for byte you must replicate that; `strict_utf8_tag_bytes_hex` is what a conventional encoder produces.

sample_signature.note: NOT reproducible: RSA-PSS is randomised. Do not assert equality on these. Splice signature_hex into unsigned_item_hex at byte offset 2 to obtain a valid signed item, then test your VERIFIER against it.

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-tag-long
vectors.description: KNOWN DIVERGENCE, other side. The same unpaired surrogate in a value over 64 bytes, where arbundles falls through to Buffer.write and emits standard UTF-8 (EF BF BD). Identical logical input to the previous vector, different bytes, purely because of length. arbundles is not self-consistent here.
